hospital_course: The patient presented with complaints of multiple episodes of loose stools, vomiting, fatigue for 3 days, and fever for one day. Initial investigations revealed a normal CBC, elevated serum creatinine (1.65 mg/dl), and low serum sodium (128.00 mmol/L). Urinalysis showed ketone bodies, pus cells, and bacteria. The patient was treated with IV fluids, IV antibiotics, IV PPI's, and IV antiemetics. An ultrasound of the abdomen and pelvis showed Grade-I fatty liver changes and features suggestive of colitis. Repeat serum creatinine was normal (1.17 mg/dl). TSH and Free T4 were normal. A stool routine showed red blood cells and pus cells. The patient was discharged at the request of family against medical advice for further management.
